title: A Wire to Romania

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: the US blockade of Iran took hold and a drone shut Iraq's Khor Mor gasfield, COP31 opened without the US, and a Cairo train crash killed seven. Markets rebounded, Moldova wired itself to Romania, and a flu shot study brought good news.

lines: The blockade's on, the talking's on,
he'll take it to Xi at the summit.
A drone put out the Khor Mor flame;
the markets climbed back up from it.
one chair left empty in the room.
Two trains met south of Cairo,
and seven won't be coming home.
But Moldova ran a wire west,
and a dog can smell what doesn't belong.
